rows.grounds: participle from iṣ with śiva object

items.question: What ordered ritual operations follow after worshipping Śiva according to rule?
premises: Worship Śiva according to rule first.
items.inference: The verse opens a sequence of post-worship offerings and balis.
uncertainties: Exact participle parsing is not fully certain.
items.plain_english: Having worshipped Śiva according to ritual, one proceeds with the prescribed offerings.

items.question: With what substance and mantra should the offering be made?
items.inference: Ghee is offered with the aghora-astra mantra.
uncertainties: Case ending of the mantra phrase is ambiguous.
items.plain_english: One should offer ghee with the Śiva aghora-astra mantra.

items.question: By whose command and with which mantra is the aghora-astra used?
premises: The aghora-astra is used from āgneya onward.
items.inference: The aghora-astra operation proceeds under Śiva's command with Sāvitrī.
items.plain_english: From āgneya onward, the aghora-astra is used with Sāvitrī by Śiva's command.

items.question: When should bhūta-bali be given after deity worship?
items.inference: Bhūta-bali follows deity worship at night.
items.plain_english: Having worshipped the deity and given bhūta-bali, one does so at night.

items.question: For what purpose is ghee offered in the directional kuṇḍas?
premises: Ghee is offered in Indra and other kuṇḍas.
The purpose is peace of directions.
items.inference: Ghee offerings in directional kuṇḍas secure peace of directions.
items.plain_english: With ghee in the Indra and other kuṇḍas, one offers for the peace of the directions.

items.question: How much bali should be given and in what manner?
items.inference: One should give bali with a tenth part, as before.
uncertainties: Exact referent of pūrvavat is implicit.
items.plain_english: One should give bali with a tenth part, as before.

items.question: With what vessels is the deity worshipped in this rite?
premises: The count ends at one hundred eight.
items.inference: The deity is worshipped with pots numbering up to one hundred eight.
uncertainties: Compound segmentation is not fully certain.
items.plain_english: With pots for the deity, ending at one hundred eight.

items.question: According to what factors should the rite be scaled?
items.inference: The rite is scaled by power and by the corresponding liṅga.
uncertainties: Exact case of the second phrase is ambiguous.
items.plain_english: According to one's power and according to that liṅga.

items.question: What quality should the rite have in relation to snapanā?
items.inference: The rite should be made suitable to snapanā.
uncertainties: The exact comparative force of yathā is implicit.
items.plain_english: And it should be suitable to snapanā, as appropriate.

items.question: Where and with what should the caru be cooked and offered?
items.inference: With brahmāṅgas, one offers in Śiva's fire and cooks caru.
uncertainties: Fused sandhi in prāgvacchivāgnau is not split.
items.plain_english: With brahmāṅgas one should offer as before in Śiva's fire and cook caru.

items.question: Who should offer and according to what capacity?
items.inference: The guru-form protectors should offer according to their power.
uncertainties: Exact referent of gurumūrtipāḥ is implicit.
items.plain_english: According to their power, the guru-form protectors should offer.

items.question: How is ghee offered after the separate full offering?
premises: A full offering is also made.
items.inference: After offering ghee, one also makes a separate full offering.
uncertainties: The exact object of pūrṇāṃ is implicit.
items.plain_english: Having offered ghee separately, one also offers the full one.
